resources.title: LearnEnglish free resources (A1 to C1)
resources.output: Study material by CEFR level A1 to C1; confirm your level with a test and list that result on your CV
resources.why_picked: Run by the British Council. Free listening, reading, writing, speaking, grammar and vocabulary by CEFR level A1 to C1, plus a free level test. A free account unlocks the full library.

evidence.claim: Homepage: 'Created by the British Council'; 'Learn with free resources' (videos, texts, audio with interactive exercises); a free LearnEnglish account gives a free English level test; online courses and IELTS preparation are listed as separate services

Free resources page lists sections for listening, reading, writing, speaking, grammar, vocabulary, business English and general English; registering unlocks the full library; community events dated up to Sep 2026
Listening section offers five levels: A1, A2, B1, B2 and C1

resources.title: BBC Learning English
resources.output: Daily listening and vocabulary practice; pair it with a certificate or test result for the CV
resources.why_picked: BBC site running since 1943. New weekly programmes (6 Minute English, The English We Speak), easy, medium and hard levels, a level test and a Work English section. Free.

evidence.claim: Homepage: 'Inspiring language learning since 1943'; easy, medium and hard levels; new episodes every week of 6 Minute English and The English We Speak; Test Your Level section
Level test page opens without login and routes learners to the matching BBC programmes

resources.title: EF SET free English test and certificate
resources.output: An EF SET certificate with a CEFR level and a personal link for your LinkedIn profile or CV
resources.why_picked: Free 50 or 90 minute test with a CEFR score and certificate, built with named assessment experts. Vendor-run, unproctored self-assessment, not an admissions or visa test: use IELTS or TOEFL for that.

evidence.claim: Homepage: free online English test with certification, 2-skill (50 min) and 4-skill (90 min) versions, a 20-question practice test, results aligned with CEFR levels

FAQ: score per skill and an official EF SET certificate with a personalised URL for LinkedIn or a CV; launched 2015; designed 'primarily as a tool for individuals to evaluate themselves'; not proctored and identity not checked; EF keeps no list of schools or employers that accept it; test design credited to named assessment experts

resources.title: IELTS official sample test questions
resources.output: A baseline band estimate from official questions, so you know what score to aim for before booking
resources.why_picked: Official practice and sample questions with answers for IELTS Academic, General Training and UKVI Life Skills, published by the test owners. Free.

evidence.claim: Page offers 'Official practice and sample questions and answers' for IELTS Academic, General Training and UKVI Life Skills; footer copyright 2026
Official preparation hub lists sample tests, writing resources and the trial test, and links partners British Council, IDP and Cambridge English

resources.title: IELTS free practice tests (familiarisation tests)
resources.output: Computer-style Listening, Reading and Writing practice with answer keys, before you sit the real test
resources.why_picked: IDP is one of the three IELTS partners named on ielts.org. Page lists computer-delivered Listening, Reading and Writing familiarisation tests and a Speaking Part 1 recording. Free.

evidence.claim: IDP page lists free computer-delivered Listening, Reading and Writing familiarisation tests (answer keys for Listening and Reading) and Speaking Part 1 audio with transcript
ielts.org lists IDP IELTS as an official partner preparation resource

resources.title: TOEFL iBT official free practice tests and prep planner
resources.output: Two full-length practice results and a completed 8-week plan, so you can set a target score before booking
resources.why_picked: Official ETS page lists free products: an interactive sample, two full-length practice tests for the January 2026 format, and a free 8-week prep planner (PDF). Paid TestReady items are separate.

evidence.claim: Prep page lists Free products: Interactive Sample, Full-Length Practice Test 1 and 2 (links named sample-test-jan-2026), and a free 8-week TOEFL iBT Test Prep Planner
Test content page shows the current task types (Complete the Words, Read in Daily Life, Write an Email, Take an Interview) and about two hours of testing

resources.title: TOEFL iBT test
resources.price_note: per test in Ukraine, excluding taxes
resources.output: An English result you can list as 'TOEFL iBT' with your score
resources.why_picked: Official ETS admissions test; ETS says 13,500+ institutions in 160+ countries recognise it. About 2 hours. US$170 per test in Ukraine, excluding taxes; US$280 in the US.

evidence.claim: ETS TOEFL page: 'Recognized by 13,500+ institutions across 160+ countries'; offers a free practice test link
ETS fees page is a country selector; prices exclude VAT or other taxes except for EU countries; other fees listed include US$49 express registration and US$29 per extra score report
ETS fee data file behind the fees page lists Ukraine at $170 and United States at $280
Test content page: sections Reading, Listening, Writing, Speaking; 'allow approximately two hours'; adaptive

resources.title: LearnEnglish Business English hub
resources.output: Practised workplace emails and interview answers in English that you can reuse in applications
resources.why_picked: British Council hub: English for emails (pre-intermediate to intermediate), business magazine, podcasts and You're Hired job-search videos, with tasks. Corporate training is separate.

evidence.claim: Page lists a business magazine (intermediate or upper intermediate), podcasts for professionals (upper intermediate), English for emails (pre-intermediate or intermediate) and the You're Hired video series (intermediate or upper intermediate); says activities develop interview skills and email writing, with tasks after each video, podcast or article; corporate training and online courses are listed as separate offers
Free resources page includes a Business English section next to the skill sections

resources.title: English at Work (animated business drama)
resources.output: Office vocabulary and phrases to use in interviews and workplace chat; no certificate
resources.why_picked: BBC animated series on office English, intermediate level, linked from BBC's Business English page. Episodes are dated 2016 and 2017, so use it for phrases, not current trends. Free.

evidence.claim: Series page: 'Intermediate level... English communication in the office'; about 67 episodes dated July 2016 to October 2017
BBC Business English page lists English at Work under 'English for Work - Business English'

resources.title: Using the STAR method for your next behavioral interview (worksheet included)
resources.output: 3 to 5 written STAR stories from the worksheet, ready for behavioural interviews
resources.why_picked: MIT career office guide: STAR time split (Situation 20%, Task 10%, Action 60%, Result 10%), a sample answer, a worksheet for 3-5 stories, and the thank-you email rule. Public, free.

evidence.claim: Guide covers behavioural questions, STAR with suggested time shares, a sample answer, preparing 3-5 stories, a STAR worksheet PDF, mock interviews and a thank-you email within 24 hours
MIT CAPD interviewing page links this guide in its how-to list and recommends mock interviews

resources.title: Симулятор співбесід (Кар'єрна студія)
resources.output: Rehearsed answers to questions generated from a real vacancy text or link
resources.why_picked: State service on Diia.Osvita, launched July 2026. Paste a vacancy and the AI asks recruiter-style questions. Free per the Ministry. Ukrainian interface; the interview language is not stated.

evidence.claim: Official Diia.Osvita page (in Ukrainian) lists 'Симулятор співбесід' among the Career Studio tools: practise hard questions, get feedback, argue a salary; next to the CV builder and cover letter tools
Official interview simulator page opens (title 'Дія.Освіта - Симулятор співбесіди'); its content needs JavaScript
Kyiv Post (UA), 8 Jul 2026: Ministry of Digital Transformation launched the Career Studio on Diia.Osvita; upload vacancy text or a link and the AI forms questions close to an employer's
Fakty.com.ua, 8 Jul 2026: the simulator takes a pasted vacancy text or link and the AI plays a recruiter conversation
Kosht.media, 9 Jul 2026: headline 'Diia.Osvita launched free AI tools for employment'; the simulator builds an interview from a vacancy text or link
Happy Monday, 8 Jul 2026: Career Studio with free AI tools; the interview simulator builds questions from a vacancy
Borg.expert: the Ministry of Digital Transformation says the service is free; practice can be repeated without limit with analysis of your answers

resources.title: English for Career Development
resources.output: A US-style resume and cover letter, plus practised networking and interview answers
resources.why_picked: Penn course for non-native speakers, US State Dept funded: resume, cover letter, networking, interviews. 4.8 from 17,027 reviews. Free via 'Full Course. No certificate'; certificate paid. US process.

evidence.claim: Course page: created by the University of Pennsylvania, funded by the US Department of State; units on job search, resume, cover letter, networking and interviews (about 39 hours of units; 4 weeks at 10 hours a week); 4.8 from 17,027 reviews

Same page: 'Anyone may take this course for free' (Enroll now, then 'Full Course. No certificate'); the no-certificate option allows required assessments and a final grade; the Coursera certificate is bought or obtained through financial aid

resources.title: Talk the Talk
resources.output: A written and practised talk with a presentation checklist, and a free OpenLearn statement of participation
resources.why_picked: Open University course, 12 hours, level 1, no prior experience: analyse TED Talks, then write and practise your own talk. Free; account needed for the statement. Last updated Dec 2019.

evidence.claim: Course page: free; 12 hours study over four weeks; level 1 introductory; no previous experience needed; create and practise your own talk; start without signing up, free statement of participation needs an account; updated 19/12/2019 (first published 02/11/2015); average rating 4.7 from 13 ratings

resources.title: Toastmasters club membership and Pathways
resources.price_note: per 6 months, plus a one-time $25 fee
resources.output: Several delivered speeches and completed Pathways projects you can list as 'Toastmasters member'
resources.why_picked: Live practice with a real audience in 14,000+ clubs, in person or online; visiting is free. Membership dues are US$72 every six months plus a one-time US$25 joining fee.

evidence.claim: Pathways page: interactive education program with 300+ competencies and 6 learning paths, online content in several languages
How to join: find a club near you or online, visiting is free; US$72 semiannual dues plus one-time US$25 new member fee; 'over 14,000 clubs worldwide'
Dues FAQ: dues are US$72 for each six-month period, one-time new member fee US$25; page last updated 07/2026

resources.title: Professional, Technical Writing (Purdue OWL)
resources.output: A business letter, memo and email drafted to the OWL's formats, kept as writing samples
resources.why_picked: Purdue University writing lab reference: memos, business letters (block, modified block, semi-block), sample emails, reports and white papers. Free, no login. Reference pages, no exercises.

evidence.claim: Section lists memos (audience, parts, format, sample), basic business letters, sample e-mails, activity and postmortem reports, technical reports and white papers
Basic Business Letter page explains letter parts and the block, modified block and semi-block layouts; run by The On-Campus Writing Lab & The OWL at Purdue; copyright 2026

resources.title: Technical Writing One
resources.output: Clear, short documents (READMEs, design notes, emails) to show as writing samples
resources.why_picked: Technical writing, not general business writing (Google says so): active voice, clear sentences, lists, short documents. Same course Google engineers take. Pre-class units total 2 hours. Updated 2025.

evidence.claim: Course page: clarity, conciseness, active voice, paragraphs, lists, document organisation; pre-class unit times add up to 120 minutes (some optional); last updated 2025-03-28

Technical Writing landing page: study the same courses Google engineers take, aimed at software engineers, CS students and product managers; 'you don't need to be a strong writer'; 'These courses focus on technical writing, not on general English writing or business writing'

resources.title: Create a good LinkedIn profile
resources.output: A complete LinkedIn profile: photo, headline, About, experience, skills and a custom URL
resources.why_picked: LinkedIn's own checklist: photo, headline, summary, experience, skills, recommendations, the profile strength meter and a personal URL. Short, free, no account needed to read.

evidence.claim: LinkedIn Help article lists photo and background image, headline, short summary, experience and education, skills, recommendations, profile strength meter and personal URL

resources.title: Build your LinkedIn profile
resources.output: A LinkedIn profile with a keyword headline, an audience-led About section and a custom URL
resources.why_picked: University career office guide: the headline is heavily weighted in LinkedIn search, how to write the About section, photo advice, custom URL and privacy settings. Public, free.

evidence.claim: Page title 'Build your LinkedIn profile'; says the headline is one of the most highly weighted elements in LinkedIn search; covers photo, About section, custom URL, privacy settings and examples

resources.title: Building Your LinkedIn Profile
resources.output: A student LinkedIn profile with a fill-in summary template, up to 50 skills and a top-3 skills line
resources.why_picked: Yale career office section-by-section guide with a fill-in-the-blank summary for students (3-5 short paragraphs, a call to action) and skills advice: top three show first. Public, free.

evidence.claim: Page covers photo, background image, headline (go beyond 'student'), summary template, experience, skills (up to 50, top three visible), recommendations, education

resources.title: Managing your profile README
resources.output: A one-page profile README on GitHub, shown at the top of your profile
resources.why_picked: GitHub's own steps: create a public repository named after your username, add a README, edit it. Takes minutes. Free.

evidence.claim: Docs page steps: new repository named as your username, Public, Add README on, Create repository, then Edit README
Personal profile concept page: the profile README is listed as a customizable element: a customizable section at the top of your profile

resources.title: Pinning items to your profile
resources.output: Up to six pinned repositories that show your best projects first on your GitHub profile
resources.why_picked: GitHub's own steps to pin up to six repositories or gists so a recruiter sees your best work first. Pair it with a profile README. Free.

evidence.claim: Docs page: pin gists and repositories to your profile; Customize your pins, reorder, Save pins; limit of six pinned repositories and gists combined
